raw_segments.text: And the sun has seen and known all this. He is a ruined man, and his fear has taught him
to knock ambition and passion headforemost from his bosom's throne. Humbled by poverty,
he takes to money-making and by mean and miserly savings and hard work, gets a fortune together.
Is not such an one likely to seat the concupicent and covetous element on the vacant throne,
and to suffer it to play the great king within him, girt with tiara and chain and scimitar.
